'''Belvyn''' was a [[Band of the Red Hand#Redarms|Redarm]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
Belvyn was one of a dozen Redarms (known to include Harnan, Tad Kandel, Lawdrin Mendair, Corevin, Lawtin, Fergin, Gorderan, Metwyn, and Wat) that accompanied [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Nalesean]], [[Vanin]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] when they left [[Salidar]] for [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|6|44}}

After residing at the Ebou Dari inn, [[The Wandering Woman]], he moved with the rest of the Band to the [[Tarasin Palace]] barracks.{{ref/book|7|28}}

Belvyn and [[Lawtin]] both accompanied Nyneave to the intended meeting with the [[Sea Folk]], however both were killed when [[Moghedien]] used [[balefire]] on the boat in which they were sailing.{{ref/book|7|37}}
